title: Emails that land on the right job (mocks example)
task: Example deck: one round with the design question as mock screens and the plan written for the recommended option
summary: One round, everything in it. The question shows its three options as strips of **mock screens**, one per step: click a screen to see it full size and leave notes on it, then **Pick** one. The intents and steps below are written for **C** (the recommended option) and follow your pick. Finalize when it is right.
goal: When an email about a job arrives, or one the app missed, it ends up on the right company and role with a reason and an Undo, and I never have to approve every small change.

steps.title: Search your mail
steps.do: Click the invite to read it, then Attach

journeys.title: Find a job in the table
journeys.summary: Column menus, chips and search work like the real table

steps.title: Applications
steps.do: Open the Where menu, pick Remote

discovered.title: Built on the current app
discovered.summary: The Applications table, the company page and the sidebar are today's, unchanged
discovered.finding: The prototype copies the real app's CSS and markup. New in this design: what the app does with new mail (the question below), **Add missing email** from the company page, emails that open in place, the **Changed by email** note with **Undo**, and the **Changes** page.

decisions.title: When the app knows where an email belongs, what happens?
decisions.summary: The app reads new job mail and finds where each email belongs. This morning three came in: Maya's reply in Dana's thread (sure), a recruiter naming two clients (unsure) and a Topgig match for a new company (unsure). Compare what happens to them.
decisions.building: What the app does with a matched email: link it and show the change with Undo (A), keep it in To confirm until you say so (B), or link the sure ones and ask about the rest (C). Add missing email, emails opening in place, and Changes work the same in all three. **Recommended: C.** The plan below is written for it; pick another and the intents follow.

options.label: A. Link it on its own
options.caption: Nothing waits for you: you check what it did and undo what is wrong. Fastest, but unsure guesses get linked too.

steps.title: New mail is read
steps.do: Open Changes (3 linked on their own)

options.label: B. Ask me first
options.caption: Nothing changes until you confirm. Most control, one more click for every email.

steps.title: To confirm
steps.do: Click Maya's email to read it

options.label: C. Link when sure, ask when not
options.caption: Same thread or same sender links at once; new companies and vague recruiters wait for you.

steps.title: The sure one, linked on its own

intents.title: Sure matches link on their own
intents.intent: I want an email the app is sure about (a reply in a thread it knows) linked to its job on its own, with a reason I can read and an Undo, so I never approve what is obvious.

verify.expected: Maya's reply shows on Northwind Labs with 'linked on its own: reply in Dana's thread' and an Undo that puts it back.

intents.title: Unsure ones wait for me
intents.intent: I want an email the app is not sure about (a recruiter naming two clients, a Topgig match for a new company) kept in **To confirm**, where I read it in place and confirm or say where it goes.

verify.expected: To confirm (2) lists the recruiter's email and the Topgig match; Confirm files the match on Northwind and the count drops to 1.

intents.title: Add a missing email
intents.intent: I want to find an email the app never read (it went to my personal inbox) from the company page and attach it, with the same Undo.

verify.expected: Add missing email opens the search, the invite attaches to Northwind, Changes logs it.

intents.title: Find a job in the table
intents.intent: I want the jobs table to filter by where and sort by pay the way it does today, so nothing I use breaks.

verify.expected: Where: Remote leaves 6 rows sorted by pay; a row opens its company.

boundaries.title: Read-only mail
boundaries.boundary: The app reads Gmail and never sends, labels or moves a message. Nothing here changes that.

steps.title: Match scoring
steps.description: Score each new email against open jobs: thread id, sender's company, role words. Sure means a known thread or a known person at one open job.

steps.title: Link sure matches with a reason and Undo
steps.description: File a sure match on its job, write the reason and a Changes line; Undo unfiles it and keeps the email in To confirm.

steps.title: To confirm
steps.description: The To confirm list on Today and its page: read the email in place, Confirm, or pick the job it goes to.

steps.title: Add missing email
steps.description: Search the mailbox from the company page, read a result in place, Attach it (same link path as a sure match).

finalVerify.expected: Maya's reply shows on Northwind Labs with 'linked on its own: reply in Dana's thread' and an Undo that puts it back.
To confirm (2) lists the recruiter's email and the Topgig match; Confirm files the match on Northwind and the count drops to 1.
Add missing email opens the search, the invite attaches to Northwind, Changes logs it.
Where: Remote leaves 6 rows sorted by pay; a row opens its company.
